scope: cooking scene inside existing preparation button
soup: Ladle scoops broth; a small drip returns to the pot; steam rises.
tossed: Paired chopsticks lift one dumpling and return it to the bowl; nearby dumplings turn gently; steam rises.
boiled: Dumplings bob in a pot; water bubbles; steam rises.
fried: Dumplings stay in a frying pan with golden undersides; small oil bubbles appear; steam rises.
loop: Only while visible and document is active
reducedMotion: Static cookware, food and visible steam strokes; no movement
invariants: Illustrative food, not a recipe or live kitchen feed
